lin_historian.text: This house was built of stone around 1160, when nearly every house was timber. Stone meant money, and safety.
Lincoln's Jewish community lived along this hill: moneylenders, doctors, scholars. Aaron of Lincoln lent money to kings and abbeys; when he died the Crown seized his fortune.
In 1290 Edward I expelled every Jew from England. They weren't allowed back for over 360 years. The house remembers them, and so should we.
